preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 500,000.
Size of the permutation N is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= A[i] <= N for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each element in the permutation A is between 1 and N.
All elements in the permutation A are distinct.

postconditions.description: The number of lines in the output matches the number of test cases T.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == N for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each line in the output contains exactly N integers.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(num) <= N for num in stdout.replace(' ', '').split())
postconditions.description: Each number in the output is between 1 and N.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(line.split())) == N for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: All numbers in each line of the output are distinct.

postconditions.expression: all(' '.join(sorted(map(int, line.split()))) == ' '.join(map(str, range(1, N + 1))) for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each line in the output is a permutation of the numbers from 1 to N.
